about: The F17 test set (o4-lead/reviews/2035/design-r5.md): every r3-r7 witness of #2035's line-level ground check, as a case on main's suite file (base and head as -U0 diffs, the base against main's file, the head against the base; a new file has no base and its head is against main's file), with the class the syntax-tree design gives it (P pass, E exemption, G ground refusal, U unsupported-syntax refusal) and the instances it stands for; and the 358 expected-value positions Codex r3 found apart from any reader of the tool ([file, line, 0-based column, text]). Generated, not written: `build-cases.py` (with `dump-builder.mjs`, which reruns the builder's probe scripts to record their texts) from #2035's review evidence; the scripts and their inputs are kept under ~/work/evidence/f17-builder/ on the LXC, and `python3 build-cases.py <checkout> <fixture>` regenerates the cases.
